interfaces.name: project announcement REST routes
interfaces.invariant: Project route, server authorization and optimistic-lock behavior remain compatible.

interfaces.name: release-calendar theme_key
interfaces.invariant: Field name and HTTP paths stay unchanged; new writes use tone-1 through tone-5 and legacy reads remain accepted.

interfaces.name: global color variables
interfaces.invariant: ProjectView reads rather than writes --brand, --success, --accent, --warning and --danger.

sensors.target: Project service behavior for R2-R4 and R6
sensors.independence: JVM tests execute service logic separately from Vue rendering

sensors.target: R1, R5 and R6 frontend integration
blind_spots: Runtime interaction and actual CSS computed color
sensors.independence: TypeScript/Vite compilation is independent from service tests

sensors.method: Backend health endpoint and frontend HTTP availability
Browser viewport, selector and computed-style inspection

actuators.action: Modify only ProjectService allowed key set/default and focused tests
actuators.rollback: Revert scoped Java diff while retaining readable stored values

actuators.action: Modify only project.ts types and API payload signatures
Modify only ProjectView option normalization and local CSS classes

disturbances.source: Existing dirty worktree from REQ-081/082 and other user work
disturbances.effect: Scope checker can report unrelated paths
Mockito/Byte Buddy tests can fail before assertions

disturbances.source: Old release-calendar values saved by rejected palette implementation
disturbances.effect: Unnormalized visual classes could lose color

delays.source: Vite hot reload and production build
delays.consequence: Immediate browser check can observe stale UI
delays.sampling_rule: Wait for build completion or reload after source save.

delays.consequence: Old service process can reject newly accepted tone keys
delays.sampling_rule: Probe health after a fresh process startup before API verification.

delays.consequence: Computed colors can change after a short animation
delays.sampling_rule: Sample computed styles after the transition completes.

assumptions.text: Existing ProjectServiceTest covers or can directly cover release-calendar request validation.
assumptions.evidence: Current test file and prior focused test result in this task context.
assumptions.falsifier: No test seam reaches releaseCalendarThemeKey validation.

assumptions.text: The current local CSS defines all five chosen variables for every palette and appearance.
assumptions.falsifier: Computed style check finds a missing/invalid variable.
